::: {#rem-running-racket}
#### Running Racket

This course writes its programs in [Racket](https://racket-lang.org/),
a programming language that grew out of Scheme, a dialect of Lisp.
Racket comes with DrRacket, the program you use to write and run Racket code,
and Lab 1 walks through using it.
Each Racket file in this course starts with the line `#lang racket`.
The [Racket Guide](https://docs.racket-lang.org/guide/) is the reference for anything these notes do not cover.

:::
